Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Summary: Acme Finance is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing summarization flows across EU customers. Key requirements called out: PII minimization, EU-only data residency, short retention for request/response logs, drift monitoring, and an explicit opt-out from any model training using customer data.

- Next steps from Redwood:
  1) Confirm how we implement a "training opt-out" at the tenant level and what evidence we can provide.
  2) Share a short data-practices summary that covers retention, logging, encryption, and regional controls.
  3) Share the opt-out form for legal to sign (attached).

I attached a one-page draft opt-out form (training-opt-out-form.pdf) and a short summary of our data practices — happy to iterate. If you confirm you want the training opt-out, please sign and return the attached form; we'll route for internal sign-off and provide a signed copy.

Questions from your side that I heard on the call:
- Will enabling opt-out affect our ability to debug issues? (Short answer: we can still keep short-lived operational logs and session-level traces for debugging; we can mask sensitive fields.)
- Can logs be retained only in EU region? (Yes — we can pin tenant storage to EU regions and encrypt with a customer-managed KMS.)

Proposed timeline: you confirm opt-out by EOD next Tuesday -> we return signed confirmation within 48 hours -> engineering applies tenant flag and regional pin.

Thanks — happy to sync if you'd like a quick follow-up call.

Rishi / Neha — Acme (Elaine + Samir) have confirmed they'd like tenant-level training opt-out. They need: 1) retention configurable to 30 days (unless extended during an investigation), 2) PII masking at ingestion and exclusion from debug logs, and 3) EU (Ireland) region pinning + KMS options. - Data residency / KMS: We can pin data to EU (Ireland) and support customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations.

Elaine / Samir / Marissa —

Attached is Redwood's signed opt-out confirmation (signed-training-opt-out-acme.pdf). Summary of commitments we have recorded for Acme Finance (tenant: acme-fin):

- Training opt-out: Redwood will not use Acme Finance production inputs (requests, responses, prompts, user-provided data) to train or update any Redwood-hosted models. This includes internal fine-tuning and inclusion in any 3rd-party model training by Redwood.
- Operational logs for debugging: We will maintain short-lived operational logs (default 30 days) necessary for incident resolution and debugging. Sensitive PII fields will be masked at ingestion; customers may optionally disable debug-level traces. Longer retention will only occur with explicit customer approval or for active investigations and legal holds.
- Data residency: All customer data for Acme Finance will be stored and processed in EU (Ireland) region projects per their request.
- Encryption: Data at rest encrypted with AES-256; customer may provide/manage KMS keys for additional control.
- Evidence: We can provide a signed confirmation (attached), a tenant-level flag showing opt-out, and a copy of the redwood-data-practices-summary. SOC 2 Type II reports are available under NDA.

Please confirm receipt. Once Acme countersigns (if required), engineering will apply the tenant flag and validate region/KMS settings in our staging tenant before production cutover.

Best regards,
